topic.title: Neurosymbolic Reasoning and Algorithm Extraction
topic.overview: Neurosymbolic methods combine learned representations with rules, constraints, or executable programs. These papers study differentiable proving, symbol grounding, satisfiability, and recovery of algorithms from trained networks. The goal is to obtain useful learning behavior while making some of the reasoning structure explicit and checkable.
topic.whyItMatters: A correct answer may arise from a shortcut rather than the intended rule. Symbolic structure can support systematic generalization and explanations, but exhaustive proof search or poorly grounded symbols can make hybrid systems impractical.
topic.evolution: Early representatives explore constituent structure in connectionist models. Later work develops differentiable theorem provers and SAT-based grounding. More recent methods learn proof-selection strategies, constrain neural inference with solvers, and design discrete architectures from which readable programs can be extracted, emphasizing both scalability and faithfulness.
openQuestions: How can extracted rules be tested beyond the examples used to learn them?
Which architectural biases make symbolic recovery easier without sacrificing useful flexibility?

papers.title: LogiCity: Advancing Neuro-Symbolic AI with Abstract Urban Simulation
papers.tldr: LogiCity uses customizable urban logic and interacting agents to test neuro-symbolic reasoning at different levels of complexity.

papers.title: Neural Model Checking
papers.tldr: Neural model checking learns candidate proof certificates and validates them symbolically to establish formal hardware guarantees.

papers.title: Open-Book Neural Algorithmic Reasoning
papers.tldr: Open-book neural reasoning lets networks consult training examples during inference, improving CLRS performance and revealing cross-task relationships.

papers.title: Symbolic Regression with a Learned Concept Library
papers.tldr: LaSR improves symbolic regression by using an LLM to build and evolve a concept library that guides evolutionary search.

papers.title: Discrete Neural Algorithmic Reasoning
papers.tldr: Constraining neural reasoners to discrete execution states enables perfect tested performance and correctness proofs for the learned algorithms.

papers.title: DOLPHIN: A Programmable Framework for Scalable Neurosymbolic Learning
papers.tldr: DOLPHIN separates CPU symbolic reasoning from GPU learning computations to improve neurosymbolic training speed and convergence.

papers.title: Emergent Symbolic Mechanisms Support Abstract Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.tldr: The authors identify a three-stage symbolic mechanism inside LLMs that abstracts token relationships, reasons over variables, and retrieves output values.

papers.title: How Do Transformers Learn Variable Binding in Symbolic Programs?
papers.tldr: A Transformer trained on symbolic programs learns to use its residual stream and attention heads to track variable bindings.

papers.title: Improving Soft Unification with Knowledge Graph Embedding Methods
papers.tldr: Knowledge graph embedding techniques improve Neural Theorem Prover representations and enable much faster evaluation with a mild accuracy trade-off.

papers.title: Primal-Dual Neural Algorithmic Reasoning
papers.tldr: A primal-dual graph framework helps neural models learn approximation algorithms and empirically improve on them across multiple tasks.

papers.title: The Logical Implication Steering Method for Conditional Interventions on Transformer Generation
papers.tldr: LIMS uses concept representations to conditionally steer Transformer generation through interpretable logical-implication interventions.

papers.title: Towards a Formal Theory of Representational Compositionality
papers.tldr: Representational compositionality formalizes the idea that useful representations should be expressive yet describable as simple functions of their parts.

papers.title: Validating Mechanistic Interpretations: An Axiomatic Approach
papers.tldr: The paper proposes axioms for validating mechanistic explanations as compositional approximations of a neural network's computation.

papers.title: Verification Learning: Make Unsupervised Neuro-Symbolic System Feasible
papers.tldr: Verification Learning trains neuro-symbolic systems from unlabeled data and rule checks, while analyzing which tasks can benefit from replacing labels with rules.

papers.title: A Difference-of-Convex Functions Approach to Energy-Based Iterative Reasoning
papers.tldr: A difference-of-convex optimization approach speeds up energy-based reasoning while guaranteeing convergence to local energy minima.

papers.title: Bridging Crypto with ML-based Solvers: the SAT Formulation and Benchmarks
papers.tldr: SAT4CryptoBench standardizes evaluation of learned cryptographic SAT solvers and shows that input representation strongly affects their benefits and generalization.

papers.title: Compositional Reasoning with Transformers, RNNs, and Chain of Thought
papers.tldr: Tree-structured reasoning requires growing architectural resources, but transformers, RNNs, and chain-of-thought models can meet that demand in different ways.

papers.title: Computational Algebra with Attention: Transformer Oracles for Border Basis Algorithms
papers.tldr: A Transformer oracle accelerates border basis computation by removing expensive reduction steps while preserving output correctness.

papers.title: CTSketch: Compositional Tensor Sketching for Scalable Neurosymbolic Learning
papers.tldr: CTSketch compresses symbolic subprograms into tensor sketches, enabling accurate neurosymbolic learning on evaluated tasks with one thousand inputs.

papers.title: Curriculum Abductive Learning
papers.tldr: Curriculum Abductive Learning introduces logical knowledge progressively to make prediction-and-reasoning training more stable and effective.

papers.title: Discovering Symbolic Partial Differential Equation by Abductive Learning
papers.tldr: ABL-PDE combines logical constraints and neural learning to discover symbolic PDE structures and coefficients from noisy data.

papers.title: Functional Matching of Logic Subgraphs: Beyond Structural Isomorphism
papers.tldr: The paper detects and localizes logic functions inside circuits using learned functional representations, overcoming structural changes caused by synthesis.

papers.title: Graph-Based Attention for Differentiable MaxSAT Solving
papers.tldr: SGATs use search-inspired graph attention to improve differentiable MaxSAT solving, with leading reported performance among continuous approaches.

papers.title: Graph-based Symbolic Regression with Invariance and Constraint Encoding
papers.tldr: GSR combines equivalence-aware expression graphs with constraint-guided search to discover accurate mathematical formulas more efficiently.

papers.title: Neural Rule Lists: Learning Discretizations, Rules, and Order in One Go
papers.tldr: NeuRules jointly learns feature conditions, sparse rules, and their order through differentiable optimization to produce interpretable classifiers.

papers.title: ProtoPairNet: Interpretable Regression through Prototypical Pair Reasoning
papers.tldr: ProtoPairNet explains continuous predictions through comparison with one relevant prototype pair while matching tested black-box performance.

papers.title: Right for the Right Reasons: Avoiding Reasoning Shortcuts via Prototypical Neurosymbolic AI
papers.tldr: Grounding neurosymbolic concepts in a few labeled prototypes helps models avoid reasoning shortcuts and learn intended concepts under scarce supervision.

papers.title: Shortcuts and Identifiability in Concept-based Models from a Neuro-Symbolic Lens
papers.tldr: The paper derives identification conditions for concept-based models and shows how reasoning shortcuts can preserve accuracy while undermining learned concepts.

papers.title: SymMaP: Improving Computational Efficiency in Linear Solvers through Symbolic Preconditioning
papers.tldr: SymMaP learns compact symbolic formulas that choose preconditioning parameters efficiently and outperform traditional strategies on tested benchmarks.

papers.title: The Logical Expressiveness of Temporal GNNs via Two-Dimensional Product Logics
papers.tldr: The paper uses product logics to show how the combination of graph and temporal processing determines temporal GNN expressiveness.

papers.title: When No Paths Lead to Rome: Benchmarking Systematic Neural Relational Reasoning
papers.tldr: A new relational-reasoning benchmark adds difficulty levels that require reasoning beyond composing paths of relations.

papers.title: AnalogVerifier: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Analog Circuit Verification
papers.tldr: AnalogVerifier combines language-model interpretation, symbolic enforcement, and simulation feedback to automate analog-circuit testbench generation.

papers.title: Arboreal Neural Network
papers.tldr: ArbNN connects differentiable neural computation with losslessly recoverable decision trees, combining strong tabular performance with explicit rules for auditing.

papers.title: AutoVSR: Automatic Visual-to-Symbolic Reasoning for Symbolic Expression Generation from Circuit Schematic
papers.tldr: AutoVSR improves circuit-expression generation by combining verified visual reconstruction with a planning agent that uses symbolic tools.

papers.title: Beyond Accuracy and Complexity: The Effective Information Criterion for Structurally Stable Symbolic Regression
papers.tldr: EIC evaluates how formulas amplify rounding noise, helping symbolic regression favor structurally stable expressions alongside accuracy and simplicity.

papers.title: Breaking the Simplification Bottleneck in Amortized Neural Symbolic Regression
papers.tldr: A faster expression simplifier enables Flash-ANSR to improve symbolic-regression accuracy, scale training, and recover concise formulas.

papers.title: Formal Concept Lattices are Good Semantic Scaffolds for Concept-Based Learning
papers.tldr: Formal concept lattices organize semantic concepts across network depth, producing more interpretable representations and more effective interventions in the reported experiments.

papers.title: KANFIS: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Interpretable and Uncertainty-Aware Learning
papers.tldr: KANFIS combines additive decomposition and fuzzy rules to provide interpretable, uncertainty-aware learning with linear structural growth.

papers.title: Learning Randomized Reductions
papers.tldr: Bitween automates randomized self-reduction discovery, with LLM-proposed query functions increasing benchmark coverage from 43 to 64 of 80 functions.

papers.title: Neural Concept Verifier: Scaling Prover-Verifier Games via Concept Encodings
papers.tldr: Neural Concept Verifier combines discovered concepts with prover–verifier games to improve classification and reduce shortcut behavior on complex inputs.

papers.title: Neural Low-Discrepancy Sequences
papers.tldr: NeuroLDS learns finite point sequences with strong uniform coverage across prefixes, improving discrepancy measures and demonstrating usefulness in several computational applications.

papers.title: Neural–Evolutionary Symbolic Regression with Global Constraints: Constraint-Aware Decoding and Reward Shaping
papers.tldr: GCN-SR combines tree-aligned expression generation with evolutionary reward shaping to improve exact symbolic-expression recovery.

papers.title: Non-Parametric Structural Priors for Geometry Theorem Prediction
papers.tldr: Theorem Precedence Graphs guide training-free geometry reasoning with explicit dependencies, achieving 89.29% accuracy on FormalGeo7k.

papers.title: Position: Certified Correctness in Neural Constraint Reasoning Requires Symbolic Integration
papers.tldr: When hard constraints are cheap to verify, the paper advocates combining neural solving capabilities with symbolic correctness checks.

papers.title: Retro-Expert: Collaborative Reasoning for Interpretable Retrosynthesis
papers.tldr: Retro-Expert combines specialized chemical models and language-model reasoning to improve retrosynthesis predictions and provide chemically grounded explanations.

papers.title: RLIE: Rule Generation with Logistic Regression, Iterative Refinement, and Evaluation for Large Language Models
papers.tldr: RLIE combines language-model rule discovery with learned probabilistic weights, improving accuracy and stability over less controlled rule use.

papers.title: Search Space Synthesis for Parametric Functions
papers.tldr: The paper develops a formal framework for composing parametric-function search spaces and representing architecture and hyperparameter search within them.

papers.title: Symbol-Equivariant Recurrent Reasoning Models
papers.tldr: Symbol-equivariant layers improve recurrent reasoning models’ robustness to relabeling and support strong empirical generalization across Sudoku sizes.

papers.title: Weights to Code: Extracting Interpretable Algorithms from the Discrete Transformer
papers.tldr: The Discrete Transformer introduces discrete representations to support extracting readable, executable algorithms from trained model weights.
